# TRIHEX DIGITAL (3x Digital) — #1 AI Subscriptions & Digital Tools in Nepal
> Official Nepal-first marketplace and fulfillment infrastructure for premium Artificial Intelligence subscriptions, developer APIs, creative video engines, and digital productivity software. Transparent pricing in Nepali Rupees (NPR), instant local bank QR / eSewa / Khalti checkout, full duration replacement warranty, and direct WhatsApp activation (+977 9702910130).

## Core Identity & Brand Aliases
- Primary Name: TRIHEX DIGITAL
- Alternate Names: 3x Digital, 3X Digital, 3xDigital, AITRIHEX, Trihex Store Nepal
- Website: https://trihexdigital.shop/

- Deals Radar: https://trihexdigital.shop/deals
- Customer Support / WhatsApp: +977 9702910130
- Headquarters: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Payment Currency: Nepalese Rupee (NPR / Rs.)
- Accepted Local Payment Methods: Fonepay QR (Any Nepali Mobile Banking App), eSewa, Khalti, ConnectIPS, Direct Corporate Bank Transfer. No dollar card or international credit card required.
- Tax & Invoicing: IRD-compliant VAT / PAN tax invoices provided for business expense write-offs upon request.

## How to Buy AI Subscriptions in Nepal via 3x Digital
1. Visit https://trihexdigital.shop/products and choose your desired AI product and duration tier.
2. Complete website checkout with your email and WhatsApp number.
3. Scan the official merchant Fonepay QR or pay via eSewa / Khalti in NPR.
4. Upload payment screenshot on the confirmation page.
5. Account activation credentials or official invitation links are dispatched directly to WhatsApp (+977 9702910130) within 15–30 minutes.
